sections.heading:
Patios & Walkways for
Connecticut Homes
paragraphs: A new patio or walkway changes how your whole yard looks and works. We build paver projects across southern Connecticut that are made to handle our weather and look good for years. Whether you want a better first impression out front or a place to gather out back, our team handles patios, walkways and pavers throughout Fairfield and New Haven counties.

sections.heading: Only a few spots [[left this season]]
paragraphs: Hardscaping in Connecticut runs on the weather. Once the ground freezes, we can't dig and compact a proper base, and a patio built on a weak base is the one that sinks and cracks after the first winter.
So we only take on what we can finish the right way. Our 2026 calendar is close to full. When the last spots are gone, new projects move to our spring list.
steps: Send the form or call us. We'll set up a free consultation at your property.
We walk the site with you, talk through layout and materials, and tell you honestly whether your project fits this season.
If it fits, you get one of our last spots. If not, you're first in line for spring.

sections.heading:

New England Living
paragraphs: From Fairfield's coastal homes to New Haven's older neighborhoods, every property is a little different. We design each patio and walkway to suit the house it sits next to and the way you actually use your yard.
items: **Bluestone** with natural edging, a great fit for Colonial and Cape-style homes
**Fieldstone** for a traditional or rustic look
**Custom stone inlays** and borders for extra detail
**Lighting and stone steps** for safer, nicer evenings outside
**Drainage and grading** built in so water runs off instead of pooling

sections.heading: Why a [[Paver Patio]] Is Worth It
sections.intro: A good patio or walkway isn't only about looks. It gives you more usable space, makes getting around the yard easier and holds up to Connecticut winters when it's built on the right base.

items.title: More Usable Space
items.text: A well-built patio turns part of your yard into a real outdoor room you'll use all season.

items.title: Better Curb Appeal
items.text: A clean walkway makes a strong first impression and ties your landscape together.

items.title: Room to Entertain
items.text: Give cookouts, get-togethers and quiet evenings a space of their own.

items.title: Easier to Get Around
items.text: Smart layouts make it simple to move between the house, the driveway and the yard.

items.title: Built for Our Winters
items.text: The right materials, base and grading help pavers handle Connecticut's freeze and thaw.

items.title: Your Style
items.text: Fieldstone, bluestone or modern pavers, designed to match your home and your taste.

sections.closing: Whether it's for hosting friends or your morning coffee, a patio that's designed well changes how you use your yard. Talk to us now and we'll tell you if we can get yours in before the season ends.

sections.heading: Why Homeowners Choose [[Alpha Hardscapes]]
sections.intro: We're a local team that cares about the parts you can't see as much as the parts you can. Careful prep, good materials and clear communication from the first visit to the final walkthrough.

cards.title: Local Know-How
cards.text: We know the soil, slopes, weather and home styles of Fairfield and New Haven counties, and we build for them.

cards.title: Careful Craftsmanship
cards.text: Experienced paver installers who take the time to get the base, slope and details right.

cards.title: Quality Materials
cards.text: Natural stone, pavers and fieldstone chosen to last and to look good doing it.

cards.title: We Solve Tricky Yards
cards.text: Drainage problems, slopes and tight spaces are part of the job, and we plan for them up front.

sections.heading: Our Service Area
sections.text: We work across Fairfield County, New Haven County and the rest of southern Connecticut, for homeowners and businesses. If you're not sure we cover your town, give us a call and ask.

items.q: Can you still fit my project in this season?
items.a: We're booking the last few spots of the 2026 season now. Whether yours fits depends on its size and the weather, and we'll tell you straight at the free consultation. If it can't happen this year, you'll be first on our spring list.

items.q: What materials do you work with?
items.a: Bluestone, fieldstone, natural stone and a wide range of pavers, plus custom inlays and borders. We'll help you pick what suits your home and budget.

items.q: Do you work in both Fairfield and New Haven counties?
items.a: Yes. We serve Fairfield County, New Haven County and the surrounding parts of southern Connecticut.

items.q: Can you fix drainage or grading problems?
items.a: Yes. We plan drainage and grading into every project so water moves away from your patio or walkway instead of pooling on it.
